description: A PHP framework that generates CRUD interfaces from existing SQL tables automatically

STSiteCreator.description: Main class that creates the web interface for database management
responsibilities: Testing functionality via debug mode (refactored into 15 focused methods)

testingMethods.testing(): Main orchestrator (~55 lines) - delegates to helper methods
testingMethods.sortTestLinks(): Sorts test links by aTestTypes order
testingMethods.initializeOrContinueTest(): Initializes new test or continues existing
testingMethods.adjustStepForPendingAction(): Handles pending JS actions and step transitions
testingMethods.collectTestStepReport(): Collects output buffer and writes step report
testingMethods.advanceStep(): Increments test step with DoubleUpdate support
testingMethods.outputTestDebugInfo(): Shows debug info for extended modes

STObjectContainer.description: Container for database objects and table management

STListBox.description: List display component for table rows

STItemBox.description: Item display/edit component for single records (INSERT/UPDATE)

debugModes.test: Activates automatic testing of all tables and containers
debugModes.test.see: Shows ALL test pages in report, even when no error occurred
debugModes.db.statement: Shows SQL statements sent to database
debugModes.table: Shows table object creation and initialization
debugModes.performance: Shows start/end time and page creation duration
